schedule.title: Mentor sessions, 15 minutes per team, booked ahead
Judging: the judges visit every team at its table

rooms.name: Mentor room
rooms.where: First floor, next to the main hall

rooms.name: Cafeteria
rooms.where: Ground floor, behind the main hall

rooms.name: Online
rooms.where: Submissions are online, not in a room.

rules.challenge: Build an AI agent that does one real job from start to finish, and prove it works on 20 real cases.
rules.submission: Submit before Sunday 14:00: a code repository and a 2 minute demo video.
rules.judging: Judges score the real job, whether the agent does the whole job, reliability on your 20 cases, security, the business model and the pitch.
rules.prizes: Prizes are announced at the opening.
